title: Soft, Moist and Gooey Cinnamon Buns
description: Vanilla pudding mix in the yeast dough gives a sweet, distinctive taste to these bread machine rolls oozing with butter laced with brown sugar and cinnamon. A vanilla-tinged glaze tops them off perfectly.
ingredients: 0.5 (3.5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix

steps.text: Place milk, 4 tablespoons melted butter, water, beaten egg, bread flour, pudding mix, sugar, salt, and yeast in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select Dough cycle.
Remove dough from machine after the cycle is done; knead 3 to 5 minutes. Roll out to a large rectangle. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Combine brown sugar, 1/2 cup softened butter, and cinnamon in a bowl; spread over dough. Sprinkle walnuts and raisins over top.

Roll dough into a log, starting with the widest end; pinch to seal seams. Cut into 1/2- to 1-inch slices; place in the prepared baking pan. Place in a draft-free space; let rise until doubled in volume.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine confectioners’ sugar, 4 tablespoons softened butter, milk, and vanilla in a small bowl; spread over warm cinnamon rolls.

video.description: When the cinnamon roll craving comes on, you’ll want to have this recipe on hand to put your bread machine on task to do the hard work for you! Combine milk, egg, butter, water, vanilla pudding mix, bread flour, sugar, salt and yeast and knead, then after rolling out dough, spread with a mixture of butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, then top with chopped walnuts and raisins. Roll, slice, rise and bake. When they’re beautifully golden and releasing warm, spiced scent, top with a rich icing of milk, confectioners’ sugar, butter and vanilla. Everyone will love these gooey treats!
